description: Every finite true set is contained in its next forward step.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.step_inflation.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.Rule α)) (X : Finset α) :
  X ⊆ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.step Γ X
